title: Representing Parsed Formats as Raw Strings
pattern: Representing structured, domain-constrained data formats (e.g., emails, URLs, IP addresses) as raw string primitives throughout internal layers.
why_bad: It destroys the invariants guaranteed by parsing. Downstream consumers must either perform defensive re-validation, risk parsing invalid inputs, or blindly trust that upstream components validated the data correctly.
detection: Match struct fields or function parameters with names like `email`, `url`, `ip`, `phone` typed as `String` or `&str`.
source: *Building Secure and Reliable Systems* by Heather Adkins et al. (Chapter 6, p. 115-116).
